cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You have such a good eye for storage. Sorting our shed could finally give your tools a proper home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Until you dump paint tins everywhere again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You could assign every shelf. I'd follow your labels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including a shelf you're forbidden to touch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. You could put it at eye level so I see what I'm missing.

mechanism: A markets shed sorting as creating a proper workshop, correcting B proposed standards while offering the control that would make B volunteer.
confusable: Generic flattery lacks the patient technical corrections and growing strain characteristic of S03.
comparison: Place-card alternative recruits through craft practice; this one through accessible tools and a storage system resistant to A own mess.
seedUse: Shed seed supplies B distrust and forbidden shelf; retain those concerns but make A demonstrate storage logic rather than promising obedience alone.
